market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Bond yields at 20-year highs create headwinds for equities, but AI/tech momentum and M&A activity provide support. Oil two-way risk (Hormuz vs. Saudi restart) adds noise. Expect range-bound S&P with sector rotation favoring tech over banks/consumer. VIX sliding on eased Iran worries but inflation data could reignite.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. OECD confirms global resilience post-Iran war. AI capex cycle and defense spending provide structural growth. However, frozen housing, consumer squeeze, and potential Fed tightening cap upside. 6-12 month path likely choppy with 5-8% equity gains if inflation stabilizes.
